scope: All critical and high severity weaknesses from the 2026-07-24 whole-project review.

decisionsLocked.ferpa: Fail closed for uploads only — resume upload/assist and staff_entered hard-gate to the local provider (503 when unavailable); chat may use cloud with consent + audit. Rewrite CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules/sage-ai.md to describe exactly this split. Owner, 2026-07-24.
decisionsLocked.kpi: Relabel the funnel step to 'Active BHAG' AND add two aggregate measures: percent with a confirmed BHAG reviewed within 14 days, and percent with a pathway linked to a confirmed goal. Owner, 2026-07-24.
decisionsLocked.registry: Generate the endpoint registry from the src/app/api route tree with a CI parity check that fails on drift, modeled on the catalog overlay-freshness test. Owner, 2026-07-24.
decisionsLocked.trackers: Unify application tracking on the Application model (it already carries verificationStatus/verifiedBy/verifiedAt and is read by four teacher surfaces). Migrate StudentSavedJob into it and bridge applied/interviewing/offer to a teacher signal that records the SPOKES employment outcome. StudentSavedJob does NOT gain verification fields — it stops being the pipeline. Owner, 2026-07-24.

findings.title: Crisis scan and staff alert run only after a fully successful model stream
findings.fix: Run detectCrisisSignal on the user message and fire recordWellbeingConcern immediately after the message is saved, before provider resolution. Keep the reply-side 988 block where it is.

findings.title: FERPA local-only routing fails open to cloud
findings.fix: Apply the locked FERPA decision: hard-gate student_record/staff_entered on the upload paths to local (503 when unavailable); allow chat on cloud with consent + audit; rewrite the two docs to describe the split.

findings.title: Resume PII flows to Gemini cloud by default
findings.fix: Covered by the FERPA decision: resume upload and assist are the hard-gated paths. Return 503 when no local provider is available rather than falling through to cloud.

findings.title: Crisis detector misses the informal phrasings this population types
findings.fix: Add contraction/slang alternations (wanna die, dont wanna be here, unalive, kms, gonna od) and method-adjacent phrases; grow the unit-test corpus; add at least one informal red-team case.

findings.title: Students can self-complete Sage-proposed goals
findings.fix: Restrict student transitions on sourceMessageId goals to dismissal until confirmed; render the proposal badge and disable the checkbox at every level; add route tests for proposed to completed.

findings.title: GET /api/progression mints XP, so attendance streaks measure page loads
findings.fix: Make the GET read-only; move the daily check-in award to an explicit POST behind a real action (mood check-in). Pass one fetched readiness result down instead of re-fetching.

findings.title: Goals-page Ask Sage injects fabricated messages into the real conversation
findings.fix: Route scaffolding calls through a non-persisting endpoint, or tag them as system-initiated and render them as such in the transcript.

findings.title: Goal hierarchy mis-wired: goals counted in progress but never rendered
findings.fix: Extract a pure buildGoalTree module with unit tests and make the renderer total (every active goal renders exactly once); enforce the level lattice at write time.

findings.title: Read-tier lookup_cert_progress mutates: creates cert rows and awards XP
findings.fix: Split the ensure-or-create path out so the lookup returns not-started; put creation behind an explicit start action. Add a test asserting no read-tier tool writes.

findings.title: Parallel tool calls cross-wire results into the wrong response
findings.fix: Key transcript records by callId and look up the matching record per tool_result event; add a two-parallel-call attribution test.

findings.title: Agent goal writes skip XP, progression and cache invalidation
findings.fix: Extract the goal-status transition (update + progression + XP + cache invalidation) into one lib helper called by both the route and the tool; audit remaining write tools for the same drift.

findings.title: Consequential rate limit double-counts; the block lands after confirm
findings.fix: Do not consume a mutate-tier unit for the proposal leg (or refund it); check-without-consume at confirm time so an approved card never fails on quota alone.

findings.title: Read-auditing wired into 1 of ~13 student-data GETs
findings.fix: Fold recordStudentView into the shared assertStaffCanManageStudent path so read-auditing is automatic for every student-data GET; wire the missing surfaces; delete unused StudentViewSurface values.

findings.title: CSV formula injection: two of four export paths bypass the safe escaper
findings.fix: Delete csvEscape and route the forms-response and coordinator monthly exports through escapeCsvValue; add a fixture proving = + - @ prefixes are neutralized.

findings.title: Default browse pool serves senior big-tech roles to TANF/SNAP students
findings.fix: Remove the hardcoded elite-tech boards from BROWSE_SOURCES (keep opt-in per class if wanted) and add a seniority heuristic on title tokens to job-quality or scoring.

findings.title: Save button silently fails for every browse job and unenrolled student
findings.fix: Covered by the tracker decision: saving a browse row creates an Application. Also surface non-OK save responses to the user instead of ignoring them.

findings.title: Two parallel application trackers, neither reaching the employment outcome
findings.fix: Apply the locked tracker decision: unify on Application, migrate StudentSavedJob, and bridge applied/interviewing/offer to a teacher signal that records the SPOKES employment outcome.

findings.title: Globally unique sourceId lets one class's scrape overwrite another's rows
findings.fix: Make the unique key compound on (classConfigId, sourceId) and key the upsert on it; add a two-configuration overlap test (scrape-engine has no test file today).

findings.title: Three of four default adapters have no fetch timeout
findings.fix: Route adzuna, usajobs and jsearch through fetchJson (or add AbortSignal.timeout); wrap the per-config loop so one class's failure does not abort the rest.

findings.title: Forms delivery degrades invisibly and can serve the wrong document
findings.fix: Log a warning with storageKey and fallback tier every time a bundled or content-dir fallback serves a request in production; add a Sentry breadcrumb; restrict the fuzzy content-dir scan to dev builds.

findings.title: Zero security scanning in CI for a FERPA-sensitive app
findings.fix: Add a dependency audit at high severity, a secret-scanning step, and a dependency-update config for the npm and github-actions ecosystems.

findings.title: 223 test files, zero coverage measurement
findings.fix: Add a test:coverage script around the existing runner, publish the summary in CI, and set the initial threshold at today's real number as a ratchet.

findings.title: E2E and a11y suites run in no workflow; the deepest spec cannot run in CI
findings.fix: Add a CI job that migrates the existing Postgres service container, seeds, builds and runs playwright; switch the orientation spec to read process.env.DATABASE_URL with .env.local as a local fallback.

findings.title: Client-side Sentry is likely dead under the Turbopack build
findings.fix: Create src/instrumentation-client.ts with the current client init plus onRouterTransitionStart, export onRequestError from instrumentation.ts, and confirm a browser error actually arrives.

findings.title: browse-refresh cron was never scheduled; the code comment claiming it is false
findings.fix: Schedule a browse-refresh pg_cron job mirroring the daily-coaching pattern, or descope the browse pool explicitly and delete the endpoint plus script. Either way the false comment goes.

findings.title: The 2,217-line endpoint registry is 92% unenforced and two months stale
findings.fix: Apply the locked registry decision: generate the registry from the src/app/api route tree with a CI parity check that fails on drift. Delete the never-read rateLimit/tokenBudget fields and dead helpers.

findings.title: Charter lapsed 33 days with its outcome loop provably dead
findings.fix: Draft the successor 90-day window in docs/PRODUCT_GUIDE.md with dates, single accountable owners, and measurable outcomes (the handoff employment arc plus the maturity deferred list are most of the draft). Closing the GitHub milestones and issues #37-#40 is an owner action outside this branch.

findings.title: The mandated reading path delivers misinformation
findings.fix: Give every routed doc a status header (current / superseded-by / archived), delete or repoint the dead content/_INDEX.md row, archive or rewrite the March roadmap, and fix DEPLOY.md's cron topology.

findings.title: Headline outcomes unmeasurable; KPI funnel overstates Confirmed BHAG
findings.fix: Apply the locked KPI decision: relabel the funnel step to Active BHAG and add the two aggregate measures (confirmed BHAG reviewed within 14 days percent, pathway-linked-to-confirmed percent).
